title: Generate FIPS parameter handling with Perl
body:
Replace the C preprocessor macros used for FIPS indicators and self-test parameters with a Perl-based code generation approach. This introduces `util/perl/OpenSSL/fipsparams.pm` and `providers/fips/fipsparams.inc.in` to generate the boilerplate code, simplifying `fipsprov.c` and reducing macro complexity.

This is the fruit of frustration after I spent half and hour piecing out how selftest params and indicators params worked out ... for the 3rd time in 3 months.

Macros are clever but also a thunderous headache to read in your mind.

A generated file can be read, can be parsed by tools, can be searched and does not confuse GDB when trying to resolve source code lines.
